svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Order approval flowchart subtitle: An order that fails the credit check must be paid up front; one over the credit limit needs a manager's sign-off kind: flowchart layout: { spacing: compact } # The approved path runs straight down the middle; each decision's other exit leaves sideways # (align puts a step beside the one it names), so the sign-off sits left and prepayment right. nodes: received: { shape: terminator, label: Order received } details: { shape: input, label: Enter order details } credit: { shape: predefined, label: Run credit check, note: Credit bureau API } credit-ok: { shape: decision, label: Credit OK? } call: { shape: manual, label: Ask for prepayment, note: Phone call, align: credit-ok } sign-off: { shape: manual, label: Manager signs off, align: limit } limit: { shape: decision, label: Over the limit? } wait: { shape: delay, label: Wait for payment, note: Up to 48 hours, align: limit } reserve: { shape: process, label: Reserve stock } paid: { shape: decision, label: Paid in time?, align: reserve } invoice: { shape: document, label: Print invoice } rejected: { shape: terminator, label: Order rejected, align: invoice } approved: { shape: terminator, label: Order approved } edges: - received -> details -> credit -> credit-ok - credit-ok -> limit: yes - credit-ok -> call: no - limit -> sign-off: yes - limit -> reserve: no - sign-off -> reserve - call -> wait -> paid - paid -> reserve: yes - paid -> rejected: no - reserve -> invoice -> approved

svg.title: Order approval flowchart
svg.desc: Order approval flowchart. 13 components. Connections: Order received to Enter order details; Enter order details to Run credit check; Run credit check to Credit OK?; Credit OK? to Over the limit? (yes); Credit OK? to Ask for prepayment (no); Over the limit? to Manager signs off (yes); Over the limit? to Reserve stock (no); Manager signs off to Reserve stock; Ask for prepayment to Wait for payment; Wait for payment to Paid in time?; Paid in time? to Reserve stock (yes); Paid in time? to Order rejected (no); Reserve stock to Print invoice; Print invoice to Order approved.

text.tspan: An order that fails the credit check must be paid up front; one over the credit limit needs a manager's
